**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Isolate imports for the trusted ledger checker**

When the orchestrator checkout contains an untracked `scripts/orchestrator/json.py` (or another module imported by `ledger-check.py`), these checks still pass because they inspect only `${check}`, while the subsequent non-isolated `python "${check}"` invocation prepends the script directory and executes the untracked module. This leaves the local-code execution path that the new tracked-and-unchanged guarantee is intended to close; invoke the checker with `-I` (the local `python --help` states that `-I` implies `-P`, which avoids prepending the unsafe path) or validate the import directory as well.

AGENTS.md reference: [AGENTS.md:L78-L78](https://github.com/mryfmo/dotfiles/blob/4cc9d2061f3121952449b1d000edca69c7bb7888/AGENTS.md#L78-L78)
